product: Power BI and Tableau Cloud connectors for BI imports (Public Preview)
tagline: You can now connect Genie Code to Power BI and Tableau Cloud with Databricks provided MCP connectors.
what_it_does: You can now connect Genie Code to Power BI and Tableau Cloud with Databricks provided MCP connectors. When you import a report with /importBI, Genie Code checks the result against the live source to improve migration quality. This feature is in Public Preview.
why_it_matters: When you import a report with /importBI, Genie Code checks the result against the live source to improve migration quality.
